method: All 83 steps and the notReplayed and exampleDiffers reasons read against the vendor's pages (GET on 2026-10-03, at the 2026-09 view): the Posts page's samples, finder sample, delete and error table; the Images, Vector Asset and Videos pages' upload samples, error table and forbidden answers; Organization Access Control's finders and Organization Lookup; the Marketing error responses' version answers and its FIELD_VALUE_TOO_HIGH; Error Handling, Rate Limiting, Increasing Access and Sign In with LinkedIn. Step 5's twelve scopes are Increasing Access's list for the Community Management API, one for one, and step 49's 100 calls a member is that page's Development tier. Each setup step checked for making an example's precondition true; each credential for the scopes and role its call needs; each id for being made before it is used; the waits for the dates the names give (the World in October 2026 for version 202609; the deletes a day after the limit, past midnight UTC). No test run, no judged file edited, nothing but GET sent to a real host.

doubts.note: A post naming an image still WAITING_UPLOAD is answered 400 MEDIA_ASSET_WAITING_UPLOAD, 'Media asset is waiting upload'. The code and words are the Videos page's error table's; no page says the Posts API answers them for an image.

The 422 is drawn by a reshare of a post whose author disabled resharing. The Posts page gives the code only as 'well-formed but could not be processed due to semantic errors' and names no case; the twin's is a fair one.

Two posts with an empty commentary are created to stand for the finder sample's, one with no content at all. The sample shows such posts answered; no page says a create with an empty commentary and no content is accepted.

Four initializeUpload variants in a row register videos never uploaded: each is one of the Videos page's published requests, replayed as published. Their lastByte is the file's last byte where the page's sample shows 4194303; the difference is declared, with the field's own description as its ground.

A 6 GB file is refused 400 FIELD_VALUE_TOO_HIGH at initializeUpload; the Videos page gives the rule ('Maximum allowed Videos size is 5GB') and the Marketing error responses page the code, and neither the answer to this request.
The 429 is reached through the World's door setting the member's limit and use; its code is the Posts table's TOO_MANY_REQUESTS.
The 426's message names the version asked for (202401) where the page's sample writes 'yyyymmdd'; declared.
